canonical_data: vault notes and generated wiki pages joined by the wiki-link graph
current_repo_note: Covers the karpathywiki Obsidian plugin alone; the headless karpathywiki-cli in green-dalii/obsidian-llm-wiki-cli is a separate dormant product. The shipped main.js bundles MIT-noticed packages listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
strengths: Personalized PageRank retrieval with no embeddings or vector database
Marketplace-listed plugin with PDF and Office ingest and an 11-language UI
Large test suite with per-task cost accounting in the release notes
weaknesses: Sibling headless CLI is dormant and outside this record
Retrieval benchmark is the project's own corpus figure
Sixteen-provider breadth exceeds what one review can exercise end to end
why_it_matters: A marketplace plugin proving graph retrieval can carry a personal knowledge wiki without embeddings.
